questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic flows in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to tell drivers turning left on green to give way to oncoming traffic first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to respond to red, yellow, or green lights and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals can be used instead of or with mechanical turn signals. When a driver's left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means they are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular sign pointing downward is always a yield sign. Slow down or stop if needed when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait until any trains have passed before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed in this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if they are crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. A traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a pedestrian crossing is coming up. Be careful and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is eight-sided and unique. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until the intersection is clear and it is safe to pass through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes moving in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It is orange during the day and appears as a red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided road and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: The road will turn sharply to the right first, then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around and go the other way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic from another road may merge into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the height of a bridge or overpass. If your vehicle is taller than the distance shown, you cannot safely pass underneath.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Deer may cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black symbols. They alert you to hazards or conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: A lane is ending ahead. Move to the left lane safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign appears near schools. It tells you to slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: A railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Do not cross until all trains have passed.
